A '''Houk gang''' was operating on [[Lijuter]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. They ordered a shipment of [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]] weapons, which they claimed never arrived, prompting Cartel to intervene. A second, fake shipment was sent, which the [[Houk/Legends|Houks]] attempted to steal as well. When the smoke cleared, the goods were returned to the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]].<ref>{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Underworld Trading|Overdue}}</ref>
